name: Ode
self_text: Hey! I’m Ode, early 20s, Canadian, and I love hanging out on my console for casual matches of Hollow Lantern—just pure fun, no coaching. I’m usually free Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday afternoon. When I’m not gaming, I’m busy podcasting about gaming and pop culture. Looking forward to some relaxed, chatty sessions!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern, otherwise it's a deal‑breaker. I'd strongly prefer that you’re available any of Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday afternoon, though it’s not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you’re into ranked matches, but I won’t rule you out over it.
